people.name: Baruch
people.line: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.

people.name: Gemariah
people.line: Son of Shaphan; official during Jehoiakim's reign; opposed burning scroll.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: New_Gate
people.line: A gate in Jerusalem during Jeremiah's time

people.name: Shaphan
people.line: Scribe during the reign of King Josiah

translations.web: Then Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the book in Yahweh’s house, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan, the scribe, in the upper court, at the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house, in the ears of all the people.
translations.bsb: From the chamber of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, which was in the upper courtyard at the opening of the New Gate of the house of the LORD, Baruch read from the scroll the words of Jeremiah in the hearing of all the people.
translations.kjv: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD'S house, in the ears of all the people.
translations.asv: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of Jehovah, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan, the scribe, in the upper court, at the entry of the new gate of Jehovah's house, in the ears of all the people.
